content:
CamThink has updated its NE301 and NE302 Edge AI cameras with long-range Wi-Fi HaLow connectivity for remote monitoring, industrial machine vision, smart warehousing, smart agriculture, smart facilities, embedded vision development, and OEM integration. Both are still based on the STMicro STM32N6 Arm Cortex-M55 microcontroller, are equipped with a 4MP MIPI CSI camera with a wide-angle or ultra-wide-angle field of view, and feature WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity. What’s new is the Wi-Fi HaLow option, and the NeoEyes NE301 model features a weather shield with an external antenna for outdoor deployments. Wi-Fi HaLow extends wireless coverage across large sites and remote locations where regular Wi-Fi may not reach. A compatible HaLow access point or gateway is required. CamThink NeoEyes NE301 WiFi HaLow The NE301 Wi-Fi HaLow is an IP67 outdoor edge AI camera with long-range wireless connectivity, battery power, on-device AI, and a new rain hood/weather shield and external antenna.
